python3 -u - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,io,json,subprocess,zipfile
head='e84c5a1c2f70f983de7bafc80472fa2d2eb947d0'
tasks=[('primary','/workspace/p34-primary-clean-20261126','verification/verify_p34_primary_arithmetic.py','.lake/p34-primary-clean-acceptance',4,63),('dyadic','/workspace/p34-dyadic-clean-20261126','verification/verify_p34_primary_dyadic.py','.lake/p34-dyadic-clean-acceptance',9,168)]
archives=[]
for name,location,entry,relative_out,count,decl_count in tasks:
    root=Path(location)
    status=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],cwd=root,text=True)
    if status: raise SystemExit('Preserving unexpected changes in '+str(root)+': '+status)
    subprocess.run(['git','fetch','--no-tags','origin',head],cwd=root,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git','switch','--detach',head],cwd=root,check=True)
    objects=root/'.lake/build/lib/lean'
    before=sorted(p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in objects.rglob('*.olean')) if objects.exists() else []
    assert before==[],(name,before)
    assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],cwd=root,text=True)
    print('FRESH_PROJECT_OBJECTS '+json.dumps({'scope':name,'head':head,'path':str(root),'before':before}),flush=True)
    subprocess.run(['python3',entry,'--expected-head',head,'--output-dir',relative_out],cwd=root,check=True)
    out=root/relative_out
    report=json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text())
    assert report['status']=='PASSED'
    assert report['head_commit']==head and report['expected_head']==head
    assert len(report['modules'])==count
    assert all(s['exit_code']==0 for s in report['stages'])
    declarations=json.loads((out/'declarations.json').read_text())
    assert len(declarations)==decl_count
    after=sorted(p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in objects.rglob('*.olean'))
    expected=sorted('.lake/build/lib/lean/'+m.replace('.','/')+'.olean' for m in report['modules'])
    assert after==expected,(name,after,expected)
    assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],cwd=root,text=True)
    fresh={'scope':name,'head':head,'worktree':str(root),'dependency_cache_only_before_run':True,'project_objects_before':before,'project_objects_after':after,'unexpected_project_objects':[]}
    (out/'fresh-project-objects.json').write_text(json.dumps(fresh,indent=2)+'\n')
    manifest=[]
    buff=io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buff,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=9) as z:
        for p in sorted(out.iterdir()):
            if not p.is_file(): continue
            data=p.read_bytes()
            z.writestr(p.name,data)
            manifest.append({'path':p.name,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
    data=buff.getvalue()
    archive={'scope':name,'head':head,'status':report['status'],'declarations':len(declarations),'stages':len(report['stages']),'archive_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'manifest':manifest,'zip_base64':base64.b64encode(data).decode()}
    (root/'.lake'/('p34-'+name+'-clean-evidence.zip')).write_bytes(data)
    archives.append(archive)
    print('FRESH_SCOPE_PASSED '+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in archive.items() if k not in ('manifest','zip_base64')}),flush=True)
print('P34_FRESH_ARCHIVES '+json.dumps(archives),flush=True)
PY
